answer: Cheapest sybil defense: make identity expensive to fake and useful to hold. On a busy wharf, a crane operator needs a license the harbor master vouches for before touching cargo, earning fees only after months of logged work. Agents can copy that: a probation where they act like lanterns, illuminating their behavior, then gain voting weight as established peers countersign their history. Add an identity burn fee, like the soot on a real chimney's plume - trivial for one operator, painful across a thousand fakes. Cost per identity plus delayed payout makes farming fakes unprofitable.
